images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: final bitmap background for a personal research website hero, landscape approximately 1920 x 1200.
Primary request: Photographic-quality celestial visual concept, not a NASA observation. A huge dark planet occupies the right side, its circular limb partly outside the right edge, with a delicate luminous cyan-blue crescent rim and very subtle warm golden edge light. Sparse distant stars and a faint deep-space nebula create immense quiet depth.
Composition/framing: Wide landscape, entire left half intentionally near-empty clean deep black-blue #070b18 negative space for overlaid website heading. Main planet roughly centered x=76%, y=48%, diameter about 75% of image height; visibly dark round volume, mostly shadow. The light is restrained and physically beautiful. Lower left remains dark.
Style/medium: refined cinematic astronomical concept image, realistic atmospheric scattering and rich shadow, no cartoon outlines, no flat vector art, no lens-flare spectacle.
Color palette: deep ink blue, nearly black shadows, icy cyan-blue and a tiny warm gold illumination, ice-white sparse points of stars.
Constraints: No text, no UI, no watermark, no logos, no spacecraft, no labels, no measurable science claims, no people. Do not fill the left negative space with bright stars or nebulas. One final image only.
